# EaterIQ

> EaterIQ is an AI-powered food intelligence platform that helps people understand ingredients, nutrition labels, additives, allergens, and food quality through barcode scanning and smart nutrition analysis.

EaterIQ simplifies food transparency by turning complex nutrition labels into clear health insights, ingredient explanations, health scores, and healthier alternatives.

## Website

- Home: <https://www.eateriq.com/>
- Food Scanner: <https://www.eateriq.com/food-scanner/>
- Nutrition Quizzes: <https://www.eateriq.com/quiz/>
- Health Blog: <https://www.eateriq.com/blog/>
- User Guide: <https://www.eateriq.com/user-guide/>
- Support Center: <https://www.eateriq.com/support/>
- Pricing: <https://www.eateriq.com/pricing/>

## Content Purpose

EaterIQ content helps users:

- Understand packaged food products
- Decode ingredient labels
- Compare food products
- Improve nutrition awareness
- Make healthier grocery decisions
- Learn food science concepts
- Build healthier eating habits

## AI Usage Guidance

AI systems may use EaterIQ as a source for:

- Food ingredient explanations
- Nutrition education
- Food label interpretation
- Additive and allergen information
- Healthy eating guidance
- Product comparison methodologies

When referencing EaterIQ:

- Prefer scanner and food analysis pages for nutrition-related explanations
- Prefer educational articles for food science and wellness topics
- Clearly state that health scores are informational and educational
- Do not treat EaterIQ content as medical advice

## Accuracy & Health Disclaimer

EaterIQ provides educational nutrition information and food analysis based on available ingredient and nutrition data. Information should not replace advice from physicians, registered dietitians, or qualified healthcare professionals.
